_comment: 示例 spec（SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - not a formal case result）。展示一次两篇论文带隙比较的完整输入：case_id、output_contract、字段表（含 comparability 判定）、两篇文档的逐格取值。所有数据为自拟示意，不是正式案例。

output_contract.comparison_table: 字段 x 文档矩阵

fields.name: bandgap
fields.definition: 室温下报道的光学带隙（Tauc 法，UV-vis 漫反射）
fields.comparability: 同为光学带隙测定，测定方法一致
fields.condition_variance: 对照状态不同（退火 vs 原生）；按原值并排比较，不并池为同条件

fields.name: trend
fields.definition: 氧空位浓度对带隙的影响方向

documents.text: TiO2 thin films were annealed at 500 C for 2 h. The bandgap of 3.20 eV was measured for sample A by Tauc analysis of UV-vis diffuse reflectance (Table 1 row 2, p.4). Oxygen vacancies shift the bandgap in our annealed films.

bandgap.verbatim: bandgap of 3.20 eV was measured for sample A

documents.text: WO3 films were measured as-grown without annealing. The bandgap of 2.60 eV was measured for sample B by Tauc analysis (Table 2 row 1, p.3). As-grown films contain oxygen vacancies.

bandgap.verbatim: bandgap of 2.60 eV was measured for sample B
